# Generated by tools/generate_gea_tanks.mjs. UTF-8 without BOM; CRLF.
# Exactly six light/medium chassis, three roles, four packages per role = 72 designs.
# Six additional flame designs: one per chassis. Total = 78.
# Economy / standard / reinforced / armored: 0 / 15 / 30 / 50 military factories.
# Chassis, gun and industry choose the active model; temporary shortages are handled by training pauses.
# Economy is a cheap riveted transition; higher packages require welded armor, not addon research.
# Gun packages never require radio, easy maintenance, or skirts; addons use unlocked-module priorities.
# All packages use optional addon priorities; base reliability is checked with those addons absent too.
# Budget/reliability checked for every possible optional-module combination, radio III worst cost.
# Country/MIO modifiers can change actual stats. Heavy/SPG/other designs use KX unchanged.
